title: Newhalo waitlist call to action
description: A closing call to action on a full-bleed amber-to-red photo: a 100px white heading on the left, and on the right three numbered steps between thin white rules over a full-width white button. The photo drifts with the scroll and the steps fade in one after another.
notes: white text over a warm photo (wraps itself in .dark); the placeholder is the theme's highlight-to-glow gradient
